definitions.reference: One textual javax.* occurrence in Java code (import, static/wildcard import, or inline fully-qualified name). Comments and string literals are ignored. Each reference is one edit in a namespace migration.
definitions.annotation_usage: An @Annotation site whose simple name is bound to a single-type javax.* import in the same file. Not an edit by itself (it follows the import), reported to size the annotation surface.
definitions.migration_required: yes when the type moved to jakarta.* in Jakarta EE 9+ (Spring Boot 3); no when it is part of the JDK (e.g. javax.crypto, javax.imageio).
definitions.layer: Heuristic from package path / file name, first match wins: repository (repository|repositories|dao, *Repository*), service (service|services|facade|modules, *Service*, *Facade*), controller (controller|api|filter|rest, *Controller, *Api, *Filter), configuration (config|configuration|application, *Config*, *Application), model/DTO (sm-core-model, sm-shop-model, model|entity|dto packages), else other.
